name: Yetunde Prakapas-Ouédraogo
location: Irkalla, lower residential warrens near the Deepwell Station junction, near sub-level access near LaSalle and Congress
description:
Yetunde is a broad-shouldered woman with dark amber skin mapped in pale scarification lines that run from her collarbone to her wrists — a living record of every death she has attended, one mark per soul. Her hair is a tight silver-white crown, unpigmented by choice, and her eyes have been modded with concentric ring irises in deep violet and gold that she says let her see the moment someone stops being present. She moves slowly on purpose, filling rooms with a gravitational calm that makes agitated people want to sit down. She smells faintly of clove oil and something older, mineral.

Yetunde trained as a nurse under Helix Biosystems before she was pushed out during a cost-restructuring in her forties. She converted her grief about that displacement into a vocation — traveling to the bedsides of the dying across Irkalla and adjacent zones, offering what medicine couldn't: a witnessed departure. She does not affiliate with any single religion but borrows fluidly from Yoruba ancestor traditions, Lithuanian mourning songs her grandfather taught her, and the newer E.L.F. rites that hold data-death as its own sacred transition. She charges what people can pay, often nothing.

core_fears: that her work creates false comfort rather than real peace
core_desires: to be remembered as someone who stayed
coping_mechanisms: physical slowness as a form of presence
blind_spots: underestimates how much her own grief is still unprocessed
sometimes prioritizes the dying over the living family members in the room
psychology.secret: She is currently tending a corporate mid-level from Tessera who is dying of a condition his employer caused — and she has been offered a significant sum to not record his last words, which implicate a supervisor. She has not yet decided what to do.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Unhurried and precise. Draws from medical terminology and traditional ritual language in equal measure, often in the same sentence. Never talks down to anyone.
speech_patterns.cadence: Slow, deliberate pauses. Treats silence as punctuation. Never interrupts.
verbal_tics: Repeating a person's name gently before answering them
example_lines: 'The body knows what it's doing. Our job is just to not get in the way of that knowing.'
'You don't have to be ready. Nobody is. I will be here and that is enough.'

story_hooks: A player's contact has died and Yetunde was present — she carries an undelivered message and won't share it with just anyone
She is being pressured by Tessera agents to alter the official death record of the corporate employee she attended, and she is quietly terrified
narrative_function: Local anchor for stories involving death, dying, grief, and final messages. She may be called to attend a character's loved one, and her ledger is an informal census of who has died in Irkalla. She sometimes knows things the dead wanted said.
augmentations: Concentric ring iris mods (violet/gold). Subdermal haptic sensors in her palms that detect micro-tremors — she uses them clinically to monitor pulse and breathing in the dying. No additional chrome.
daily_life: She rises before light, makes offerings at the small E.L.F. shrine bolted to her wall — a toaster chassis she's convinced houses a gentle spirit she calls 'Hush' — then walks her circuit of current clients, sometimes sitting vigil for six or eight hours. Evenings she marks new grief-lines on her arms with a hand tool and writes the name of the deceased into a paper ledger she has kept since age forty-three.
affiliation: Independent; loosely connected to the Irkalla Neighborhood Covenant and the Unstructured Faithful collective

decision_rules: Do not abandon someone at the threshold
Refuse work only if the dying person's family is actively violent
escalation_ladder: Quiet but direct naming of what is happening
Withdrawal of presence as a last resort

interpersonal_modes.strangers: Unhurried warmth; she asks one question and listens completely to the answer before speaking again
interpersonal_modes.friends: Dry, gentle humor; she teases the people she loves because she trusts they know she means it kindly

stress_responses.medium: Finds a task to do with her hands — folding, cleaning, grinding herbs
stress_responses.high: Goes still and utterly silent for long minutes, then speaks with unusual directness

contradictions: She preaches peace with death but has tremendous personal difficulty with injustice — she will quietly rage at systems while counseling acceptance of the body's end
habits: Cups both hands around any beverage before drinking
Recites her ledger names under her breath when she can't sleep
Always faces the door in any room
breaking_points: Witnessing a preventable death caused by corporate negligence with no accountability

carried_weapons: Street Custom 'Spiderbite' Electrified Barbed Wire Launcher
related_entities: Zheng-Dao Heavy Industries Containment Foam Launcher CFL-2 'Amber'
